summary: Cebu 2nd District representative with 76 principal-authored bills. Authored free annual medical check-ups, a health emergency reinforcement team, hospital bed capacity rules, an anti-dynasty ban and drunk-driving penalties. Co-authored the national minimum wage, petroleum excise suspensions, income tax restructuring and body-worn cameras for police.
caveat: Anti-dynasty and body-worn camera items are single issues and unscored. Co-authored tax bills are ambiguous in direction.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free annual medical check-ups (-3); co-authored the national minimum wage (-2) and petroleum excise suspension (+1) with income tax restructuring (direction unreviewed). Net slight left.
